title: Sere Talon
description: Upon pickup, add 2 random Curses and 3 Wishes to your Deck.
flavor: Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...
notes: Upon obtaining this relic, 2 randomly selected Curses (distinct, no duplicates) from the unlocked Curse pool are added to your deck, along with 3 Wishes cards. Curses must be able to be generated by modifiers. Cards are added with visual preview animations and brief delays between each group.
